turns.input: Playback keeps showing a warning about our Cloud Pro payment, is our account about to get shut off?
turns.reply:
Let me pull up that account.

I can verify whether there’s a billing issue if you share the six-digit Organization ID from Playback Settings > About.

Let me pull up that account.

Your Cloud Pro renewal payment was declined, but your features will keep working through November 11. Billing needs to update the payment method before then; would you like me to connect you with the billing team?

diagnosis.next: Tell the caller their features still work for now and that the payment method needs updating with billing before the grace period ends. Offer a handoff or callback with the billing team; do not troubleshoot the warning as a bug.
diagnosis.summary: Cloud Pro renewal payment failed on 2026-10-28; access continues until 2026-11-11.

result.next: Tell the caller their features still work for now and that the payment method needs updating with billing before the grace period ends. Offer a handoff or callback with the billing team; do not troubleshoot the warning as a bug.
